transcript.text: hotpoint SA2 oven not heatin on fan, grill ok. wat does SA2 mean??

SA2 is a model series code for Hotpoint ovens; it identifies the specific design but isn't an error code. It is very common for these elements to burn out internally while other parts of the oven remain functional. 1. Is the clock/timer set to 'Manual' mode? (If there was a recent power cut, ovens often default to 'Auto' and won't heat until reset).
2. With the oven off and cool, look at the back element inside the fan cavity. Do you see any visible cracks or damage? Please let me know if the clock is set correctly and what you see on that element.
yes clock is in manual. the fan at the back isnt spinning tho, just a low hum from it. grill still works fine

The low hum combined with a non-spinning fan suggests the fan motor has seized up—likely due to worn bearings—or there is something jamming the blade. The grill working suggests the main power supply to the oven is fine, but because the fan isn't turning, the element (which sits behind it) cannot circulate heat. Please do this check:
1. Ensure the oven is switched off at the wall and completely cool.
2. Reach into the back of the oven cavity and try to turn the fan blade by hand. 3. If you can, remove the rear cover (usually held by a few screws) to see if anything is stuck or if the blade spins freely once unobstructed. If it feels stiff, gritty, or won't turn at all, the motor needs replacing. If it spins freely but still hums and doesn't start when switched on, the motor's internal capacitor may have failed (also requiring a new motor). Let me know if it is stuck or free.
isolated it at the cooker switch and tried the blade by hand. its very stiff and feels gritty

The gritty, stiff feeling suggests that the fan motor bearings have seized. This is why it hums but won't turn; the motor is trying to start but can't overcome the friction. Because the fan isn't spinning, the hot air isn't circulating around the element, so your oven doesn't heat on the fan setting. The grill works because it uses a different heating path that doesn't rely on this fan. This involves removing the rear panel inside the oven and disconnecting the electrical terminals. If you are comfortable working with isolated mains wiring and replacing internal components, you can source a compatible Hotpoint SA2 fan motor kit. If not, please call an engineer to carry out this replacement safely.
